item.title: Man Utd score twice in stoppage time to share points in eight-goal thriller
item.description: Manchester United twice come back from two goals down to earn a point against Aston Villa in an eight-goal thriller at Old Trafford, although they will go into the international break in the Premier League relegation zone.

item.title: Brighton breeze past 10-man Brentford to move up to second
item.description: Diego Gomez's long-range strike fires Brighton to a 2-0 over Brentford, who saw Igor Thiago be shown a straight red card, as Fabian Hurzeler's side move up to second in the Premier League.

item.title: Liverpool dispatch Palace to pile pressure on Sage
item.description: Liverpool see off Crystal Palace 3-1 at Selhurst Park as Pierre Sage's side suffer their fourth defeat in a row in the Premier League.

item.title: Struggling Sunderland beat Chelsea to move off bottom of Premier League
item.description: Sunderland held on to their first Premier League win since August as Enzo le Fee's penalty help the hosts sink Chelsea at the Stadium of Light.

item.title: Bournemouth continue winning streak with Ipswich win
item.description: Evanilson scores for the fifth Premier League game in a row as Bournemouth's impressive winning streak continued with a controlled victory over Ipswich.

item.title: What can you read into Premier League table after 10 games?
item.description: With 10 games gone in the Premier League season, BBC Sport looks at what history tells us we can read into the table at this stage.

item.title: Dorgu makes dramatic impact - Man Utd v Aston Villa ratings
item.description: Man Utd fight back from two goals down twice in 4-4 draw with Aston Villa - but who did well and who didn't in player ratings?

item.title: Are 'outstanding' Brighton now Arsenal's main title challengers?
item.description: After moving up to second in the Premier League, could Brighton really be Arsenal's main title challengers?

item.title: 'Tinkerman' Alonso's Chelsea side still searching for identity
item.description: Xabi Alonso's frustration is evident as Chelsea's struggles for an identity continue with the disappointing 1-0 defeat by Sunderland.

item.title: Leeds condemn racist abuse of Bogle after Tel incident
item.description: Leeds United condemn the "disgusting" online racist abuse directed towards defender Jayden Bogle following Saturday's 1-0 win against Tottenham.

item.title: Man Utd making it 'hard on ourselves' - Carrick
item.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick admits his side "made it hard on themselves" after they twice came back from two goals down to earn a 4-4 draw at home to Aston Villa.

item.title: Fan injured after falling through hole in stand
item.description: One fan is taken to hospital after a number of Bodo/Glimt supporters fall through a hole in the away stand at Tromso.

item.title: Where does Man Utd 4-4 Villa rank among best Premier League games?
item.description: Where does Manchester United 4-4 Aston Villa rank among the Premier League's greatest games?

item.title: Chengdu blow 12-point lead to miss out on Chinese title on final day
item.description: Chengdu Rongcheng lose their final four matches of the season to give up a 12-point lead and throw away the Chinese Super League title.

item.title: Seventh-tier Wimborne knock out League Two Crawley in FA Cup upset
item.description: Seventh-tier Wimborne Town beat League Two Crawley in a huge FA Cup upset, to reach round two of the competition for the first time in their history.

item.title: Grimsby fight back from two goals down to edge Stafford on penalties
item.description: League Two side Grimsby Town recover from a two-goal deficit against the FA Cup first round's lowest-ranked team, Stafford Rangers. Grimsby battled back to level the tie at 3-3 before winning 3-2 in the penalty shootout to book their place in the second round.

item.title: London City thump Birmingham to close gap on second
item.description: London City Lionesses defeat Birmingham City 4-1 to move to within four points of second-placed Chelsea in the WSL.

item.title: 'Frustrated and disappointed' - Emery on Man Utd draw
item.description: Aston Villa manager Unai Emery was a frustrated figure after his side surrendered a two goal lead against Manchester United twice, leaving Old Trafford with a point from their 4-4 draw.

item.title: 10-man Stockport come from behind to survive huge scare at Cray
item.description: League One Stockport County survive a scare to beat Isthmian League side Cray Wanderers 3-2 after extra time in the FA Cup first round.
